proposed_new_baseline.existing_other_source_and_settings_rows: Must be fully inventoried and pinned from fresh actual bytes before future admission; this proposal does not assert full current-tree stability
proposed_new_baseline.project_auditor_gate: Adopting existing Auditor bytes as source requires explicit source review, new tracked commit/candidate and clean strict preflight; no whitelist for the currently untracked file
proposed_new_baseline.user_and_global_state_gate: Local exact bytes may be proposed without mutation; never commit session layout as portable source, normalize it, or silently omit it from snapshots

successor_controller_requirements.authorization_contract: A newly reviewed controller must consume a fresh explicit Root authorization bound to new candidate HEAD,parent,complete source manifest,controller/test/peer receipt hashes,project path,checked wrapper,timeout and expiring unique nonce. This disabled JSON is never itself a launch packet.
prelaunch_gates: Reject this disabled/unapproved packet; do not derive execution authority from it
Require new exact reviewed source commit,parent,branch and entire tracked/untracked clean Git status; include Auditor config in source manifest if adopted
Require all fresh Assets/Packages/ProjectSettings and UserSettings rows plus explicit exact global-GUI scope; refuse unknown paths/types/symlinks/reparse/owner or byte mismatch
Require current Hub open/authenticated, exact actual Editor/Android/SDK/tool pins and current capacity; no project owner and no interference with SCN13 or any other Editor
Require independently reviewed successor controller/tests and exact fresh expiring one-use Root launch authorization; no consumed r6 reuse

Resolve global GUI scope and shared-writer risk before launch: no other Editor/profile writer may race observed shared settings, or a supported reviewed isolation mechanism must be proven. Defer without stopping other processes if ownership is uncertain
runtime_and_terminal_contract: Record tool session, controller PID/birth, original wrapper Popen PID/birth and project bindings before polling
Maintain same original Popen through actual exit and explicit reaping even if observation fails; preserve first failure latch and all raw evidence; never adopt/name-kill processes
Use two owned-worker absence samples plus final ownership check; no source/settings/global-GUI action before owned shutdown; protect unrelated Editors

Capture complete raw after project/source/settings and agreed global-GUI inventory; any added/removed/changed/unreadable/unexpected file or identity is a failed run. No ignore list, YAML normalizer or dirty whitelist
No automatic restoration, removal, source edits or baseline advancement. Preserve all unexpected bytes and report failure; any recovery needs a distinct reviewed scope
Compare original and terminal exact byte/existence hashes across the full declared scope; report observed boundary coverage honestly and do not claim detection of unobserved transient writes
Markers, actual wrapper exit, owned shutdown, source/settings stability, compiler consumption, in-process environment, frame/input lifecycle and normal mission/device acceptance remain separate gates

global_gui_scope_limit.must_block_launch_until_explicit_scope_p: The one-path hash cannot prove that all other GUI preferences are unchanged. No claim of every-global-file coverage is made. A complete approved inventory or proven supported isolation policy is required before the future lane can assert such coverage.

unproved_claims_not_required_for_explici.rule: Explicit reviewed config bytes do not require universal-default proof; boundary hashes cannot assert transient write detection. Neither unproved claim may be advertised as passed.
